# Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted

Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted is a Danish clinical center treating patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) as part of the DANIBD national registry. During the October 2023–September 2024 reporting period, the center managed 271 patients receiving biological therapy (BMSL), with 168 patients (62%) diagnosed with Crohn's disease and 103 patients (38%) with ulcerative colitis.[^src1]

The center's patient cohort reflects the epidemiological profile documented across Danish IBD treatment centers during this period. The DANIBD registry, from which this data is drawn, captures comprehensive information on patient characteristics, biological drug treatment patterns, surgical interventions, and comorbid conditions such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) across adult and pediatric populations at Danish hospitals and specialist centers.[^src1]
